metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Account Settings, clicked Account Actions > Remove Account, confirmed removal in dialog, and clicked OK. The email anonym-x2024@outlook.com was successfully removed. Only Local Folders and Outgoing Server (SMTP) remained.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird account settings, trigger account removal dialog, confirm removal via UI
metadata.explanation: Evaluator closes Thunderbird to flush prefs.js, then greps prefs.js for the target email. If the email is absent, score is 1.0. Initial state has the email in prefs.js, so negative control passes (score 0.0 before task).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads prefs.js after Thunderbird is closed (via postconfig close_window), ensuring the file is flushed and reflects the current account state.
Thunderbird stores account configuration including email addresses in prefs.js; absence of the target email from prefs.js is a valid and direct signal that the account was removed.
Case-insensitive grep (-i flag) is appropriate for email address matching.
Metric logic is straightforward and correct: returns 1.0 iff account_removed matches expected (True).
Negative control resistance is sound: initial state has the email in prefs.js, so evaluation before task completion would correctly return 0.0.
Error handling in getter returns account_removed=False on bash failure, preventing false positives.
The single instruction requirement (remove the account) is fully covered by the single evaluator check.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: The profile directory path '/home/user/.thunderbird/t5q2a5hp.default-release/prefs.js' is hardcoded; consider dynamically resolving the profile directory (e.g., using 'find /home/user/.thunderbird -name prefs.js') to make the evaluator more robust across different setups.
